versions.subject: feat: add new linux rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/vim'
        - '/rvim'
        - '/vimdiff'
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -c '
        - ' --cmd'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ':!/'
        - ':py '
        - ':lua '
        - '/bin/sh'
        - '/bin/bash'
        - '/bin/dash'
        - '/bin/zsh'
        - '/bin/fish'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*/vim", "*/rvim", "*/vimdiff") CommandLine IN ("* -c *", "* --cmd*") CommandLine IN ("*:!/*", "*:py *", "*:lua *", "*/bin/sh*", "*/bin/bash*", "*/bin/dash*", "*/bin/zsh*", "*/bin/fish*")
